# Legacy Office Test Fixtures (`.doc`, `.xls`, `.ppt`)

Small binary fixtures used by `apps/shell/tests/legacy-converter.test.ts` to test
CFB container pre-checks, password-protection detection, OOXML output validation,
and `soffice.bin` headless conversion.

## Provenance & License

- `g0-legacy-sample.doc`, `g0-legacy-xls.xls`, `vn-template.doc`, `vn-budget.xls`,
  `broken-truncated.{doc,xls,ppt}`: synthetic test fixtures generated by the UniWork
  Office test suite (Apache-2.0).
- `poi-test-fields.doc`, `poi-FormatKM.xls`, `poi-WithMaster.ppt`,
  `poi-PasswordProtected.doc`, `poi-password_cryptoapi.doc`, `poi-password.xls`,
  `poi-xor-encryption-abc.xls`, `poi-Password_Protected-hello.ppt`,
  `poi-ppt_with_png_encrypted.ppt`: copied from the Apache POI `test-data/`
  corpus (`https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/trunk/test-data`), licensed under the
  **Apache License, Version 2.0** (`http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0`).
